skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply various econometric models, estimation methods, and statistical inference to solve economic, financial, and business problems.
Construct, estimate, and evaluate econometric models using specialized software, interpret results to support decision-making and policy analysis.
Conduct independent and group research projects using econometric methods, select appropriate models, and analyze data.
Analyze and interpret data using econometric models and software tools.
Design and execute quantitative research projects, including data collection, model building, and result interpretation.
Build and evaluate econometric models for various types of data and research questions.
Use specialized software (Eviews, R) for econometric analysis.
Apply mathematical concepts in econometric modeling and analysis.
Critically evaluate econometric models and their applications in real-world scenarios.
Work effectively in teams to solve complex econometric problems.
Effectively communicate research findings and model results.
